headline: Occupancy hits record high; dividend and outlook raised
summary_short: Kimco's Q2 2026 revenue rose 4.9% y/y to $550.8M while diluted EPS fell to $0.22 from $0.23, as the REIT reported FFO per diluted share of $0.46 (+4.5% y/y) on record 96.4% portfolio occupancy.
summary_long: Revenue grew 4.9% y/y to $550.8M on same-property NOI growth of 3.5%, driven by a 2.6% rise in minimum rents; net income fell 5.9% y/y to $153.3M and diluted EPS to $0.22 from $0.23, as a $37.6M drop in gains on property sales offset higher rental revenue and joint-venture income. FFO per diluted share rose 4.5% y/y to $0.46. The company raised its quarterly dividend 12% to $0.28/share, issued $600M of exchangeable senior notes, and repurchased $104.7M of common stock. Cash rose to $699.2M from $168.4M q/q on the notes issuance. Kimco raised full-year 2026 guidance: net income per diluted share to $1.00-$1.03 (from $0.83-$0.87) and FFO per diluted share to $1.83-$1.84 (from $1.81-$1.84).
